title: Herby Silky Middle Eastern Yogurt Labneh
description: A savory and silky Middle Eastern dish featuring genmaicha and char-grill-yang flavors, perfect for a date night, made with labneh, a type of yogurt cheese, and a blend of Mediterranean herbs.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the labneh, genmaicha tea, char-grill-yang seasoning, and Mediterranean herb mix until smooth.
Add the lemon juice, garlic, and salt, and whisk until well combined.
With the bowl placed over an ice bath, slowly pour in the olive oil while continuously whisking the mixture until it thickens and emulsifies.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, give the labneh a good stir and spoon it into individual serving cups or a large serving dish.
Garnish with additional Mediterranean herbs, if desired.
Serve chilled, garnished with a sprinkle of sumac or paprika, if desired.
